name: apple-files
description: Inspect and manage local files and folders inside allowed roots on macOS.
long_description: Local MCP server for scoped file, Finder-adjacent, and iCloud Drive workflows on macOS. Use it to inspect directories, search files, read text files, prepare attachments, reveal paths in Finder, manage Finder tags, and perform bounded file mutations inside explicit allowed roots.

files_safety_mode.title: Files safety mode
files_safety_mode.description: Type exactly one of: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access. safe_readonly: browse, search, and read files only. safe_manage: also create folders, move, open, reveal, and tag files. full_access: also delete files. This bundle's default is safe_manage. Sets APPLE_FILES_MCP_SAFETY_MODE.

files_allowed_roots.title: Folders the Files tools may access
files_allowed_roots.description: Comma-separated folder paths; ~ means your home folder. The assistant cannot see files outside these folders. Sets APPLE_FILES_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS.
